THE FILER ADDED AN UNPROMPTED ANNOTATION in the margin below line 7, carried verbatim in totals_verbatim as filer_annotation_below_line7: '( LOAN TO SELF FOR NON CONTRIBUTION COVERED CAMPAIGN EXPENSES.' - the word read as COVERED is the one ambiguous word (it could be read GOVERED/GOVERNED from the glyphs), hence medium confidence; the opening parenthesis is unclosed as printed. It appears to explain that the reported money is a self-loan, not third-party contributions. Office Seeking reads simply 'Sheriff'; index.csv says 'County Sheriff' - same office.
